title: Report errors by service
objective: Implement src/report.cjs as a dependency-free Node CLI reading JSONL from stdin. Ignore blank lines. Each nonempty line must be a JSON object with string service and level fields. Count records whose level is exactly error by service and write a compact JSON object with service keys sorted lexicographically, followed by a newline. For malformed JSON or invalid records, write an error mentioning the physical line number to stderr and exit nonzero.
